plain_english_summary: This is the cheapest serious backend stack for a US and UK beauty dropshipping launch. Accounts and credentials still need to be created by the user outside Git.

integrations.why: Handles product catalogue, checkout, customers, orders, payments, tax settings, markets, and app ecosystem.
Creates separate US and UK market behaviour, including USD and GBP presentation.

integrations.starting_tool: DSers plus CJdropshipping plus EPROLO tests
integrations.why: Low-cost routes for product testing and sample ordering before direct launch.
Lowest complexity payment route inside Shopify.
Built-in tax calculation support for US, EU, and UK regions, with accountant review before live collection.

integrations.starting_tool: Shopify duties and import taxes settings where plan and carrier support allow
integrations.why: Reduces surprise costs for US and UK customers when cross-border shipping is used.

integrations.starting_tool: Shopify fraud analysis and manual review queue
integrations.why: Keeps risky orders from being sent to suppliers automatically.

integrations.starting_tool: Shopify analytics, GA4, and Google Tag Manager
integrations.why: Tracks traffic, product events, checkout behaviour, and revenue.
Low-cost starting point for order-adjacent and lifecycle emails.
Low-cost support inbox before volume justifies Gorgias or Zendesk.
Reviews should start after fulfilment quality is proven.

integrations.starting_tool: Shopify exports first, QuickBooks or Xero later
integrations.why: Avoid paid accounting sync before there are real transactions.

integrations.starting_tool: Manual SOPs first, Make or Zapier later
integrations.why: Automate only after repeated manual tasks are proven.

secrets_policy: No API keys, passwords, tokens, payment secrets, or supplier credentials may be committed to this repository.
